module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.CommonHeadCodeDefinitions
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.CommonHeadCode.Targets
open CommonHeadLargeGuards CommonHeadCompiler
/-- Numerical large-branch code is literal encoding of the accepted guard AST. -/
def LargeCodeExact : Prop:=∀ K cs desired,largeCode K cs desired=encode (largeFormula K cs desired)
/-- Numeric deletion code performs the actual original-index restoration. -/
def GuardCodeExact : Prop:=∀ i c p,guardedCode i c (encode p)=encode (CommonHeadGuardReindex.guarded i c p)
/-- Complete finite call tree has actual lower fuel; assembling its actual
child results gives the exact literal compiler, with no recursive-call oracle. -/
def RecursiveCodeEquation : Prop:=(∀a:Input,∀b∈children a,b.1<a.1)∧
  ∀a:Input,recursiveCode a=assemble a ((children a).map recursiveCode)
/-- Both numerical interfaces for the actual finite stack interpreter are
genuinely computable on all input codes. -/
def CodeInterfaces : Prop:=Computable children∧Computable₂ assemble
end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.CommonHeadCode.Targets

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.CommonHeadCompilerDefinitions
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.CommonHeadCompiler.Targets
open CommonHeadLargeRow CommonHeadLargeGuards
/-- The literal terminating finite guard compiler has exact truth for every
genuine source valuation, including dependent/repeated input values, signed
cancellation, empty rows, arbitrary desired signs and ALL finite exceptions. -/
def ExactFuelCompiler : Prop := ∀ fuel (rho:NONote),Order.IsSuccLimit rho.1.repr→
  ∀ K cs desired (ν:Nat→Nat),cs.length≤fuel→
  (∀ i<cs.length,actualOrdinalNorm rho.1.repr≤ν i)→
  ((compileFuel fuel (rawNoteEncode rho.1) K cs desired).eval ν ↔
    Int.sign (value rho.1.repr K (inputRow cs ν))=desired)
/-- No fresh index enters a recursively generated guard. This is essential
for later substitution of all guards into the SAME raw-variable assignment. -/
def ExactOriginalSupport : Prop := ∀ fuel h K cs desired,
  ∀ i∈(compileFuel fuel h K cs desired).variables,i<cs.length
/-- Source row instance, using exactly its actual occurrence count as fuel. -/
def ExactSourceRowCompiler : Prop := ∀ (rho:NONote),Order.IsSuccLimit rho.1.repr→
  ∀ K cs desired (ν:Nat→Nat),
  (∀ i<cs.length,actualOrdinalNorm rho.1.repr≤ν i)→
  ((compile (rawNoteEncode rho.1) K cs desired).eval ν ↔
    Int.sign (value rho.1.repr K (inputRow cs ν))=desired)
/-- Genuine numeric algorithm on ALL codes, not existence of a mathematical
formula and not a supplied closure/decision oracle. This is separately pending
until actual computation is proved. -/
def AllCodeEffectivity : Prop := Computable (fun p:Nat×Int×List Int×Int=>compileCode p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2)
end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.CommonHeadCompiler.Targets

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.CommonLayerProgramDefinitions
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.CommonLayerProgram.Targets
/-- Exact all-code equation of the ACTUAL nested compiler: finite instruction
children strictly reduce layer count and their assembly equals literal BASE
formula output. No semantic-equivalence surrogate or supplied recursion law. -/
def ExactFiniteCallEquation:Prop:=
  (∀a b,b∈children a→measure b<measure a)∧
  ∀a,recursiveCode a=assemble a ((children a).map recursiveCode)
/-- Actual numeric child/assembly interfaces required by the proved uniform
finite graph algorithm. They must be constructed, not supplied as premises. -/
def NumericalInterfaces:Prop:=Computable children∧Computable₂ assemble∧Computable measure
end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.CommonLayerProgram.Targets

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.FiniteGraphDefinitions
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.FiniteGraph.Targets
/-- The real complete finite graph, including duplicated child occurrences,
is uniformly computable from actual computable numerical interfaces. -/
def UniformGraph : Prop:=∀ (A B:Type) [Primcodable A] [Primcodable B] [DecidableEq A]
  (children:A→List A) (assemble:A→List B→B) (μ:A→Nat),
  Computable children→Computable₂ assemble→Computable μ→
  Computable₂ (graph children assemble μ)
/-- The WHOLE bounded-depth graph evaluates to the true recursive value.
The source compiler's occurrence-count measure is explicitly computable;
no recursive-call or termination oracle is assumed. -/
def ExactDecreasingGraph : Prop:=∀ (A B:Type) [Primcodable A] [Primcodable B] [DecidableEq A] [Inhabited B]
  (children:A→List A) (assemble:A→List B→B) (μ:A→Nat),
  Computable children→Computable₂ assemble→Computable μ→
  ∀ f:A→B,(∀a,∀b∈children a,μ b<μ a)→
  (∀a,f a=assemble a ((children a).map f))→
  (∀a,graph children assemble μ a (μ a+1)=[(a,f a)])∧Computable f
end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.FiniteGraph.Targets
